title: list_agents — output
description: Output schema for the SOX list_agents operation. Returns the server-tracked liveness table for all agents matching the input filters. Presence states are server-derived from heartbeat timing per spec/primitives/presence.md §3.

agents.description: List of agent liveness records known to this server. May be empty if no agents have ever sent a heartbeat, or if all known agents are filtered out.

agent_id.description: The authenticated agent identity (from spec/ports/identity.md). Matches the agent_id field in sox/presence channel events.

presence_state.description: Server-derived presence state. 'stale' means no heartbeat within 30s; 'offline' means no heartbeat within 90s or agent explicitly sent offline status. See spec/primitives/presence.md §3.

last_heartbeat_at.description: Unix timestamp (nanoseconds) of the most recent heartbeat received from this agent. Zero if the agent was registered but has never heartbeated (e.g. appeared via identity verification only).

namespace.description: Namespace the agent authenticated into, or null if namespaces are not in use.
